title: Reflection Is Not Always Worth It: Budgeted Reflection Allocation for Recommendation Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.19847v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This work aims to make recommendation agents more efficient by reducing unnecessary LLM reflection while preserving full-catalog ranking and inference reranking. Since BRAVE changes only how training-time reflection is allocated, it does not introduce new user data requirements or additional LLM exposure beyond the base agent protocol. The main potential risk is that a poorly calibrated allocator may assign less reflection to users whose preferences are sparse, niche, or under-represented, which could weaken personalization for those users or indirectly affect item exposure.   This risk can be mitigated through deployment-time auditing and conservative allocation design. In practice, reflection budgets should be evaluated not only by aggregate Recall or NDCG, but also across user-history lengths, item popularity groups, and application-relevant cohorts when such analysis is permitted. translated_title: 反思并非总是值得的：面向推荐智能体的预算化反思分配
translated_abstract: 这项工作旨在通过减少不必要的LLM反思来提高推荐智能体的效率，同时保留全目录排序和推理重排序能力。由于BRAVE仅改变训练时反思的分配方式，因此它不会引入新的用户数据需求，也不会在基础智能体协议之外增加额外的LLM暴露。主要的潜在风险是，校准不佳的分配器可能会对偏好稀疏、小众或代表性不足的用户分配较少的反思，这可能会削弱这些用户的个性化效果或间接影响物品曝光。这种风险可以通过部署时审计和保守的分配设计来缓解。在实践中，反思预算不仅应通过总体Recall或NDCG来评估，还应在允许的情况下跨用户历史长度、物品流行度分组以及与应用相关的用户群体进行评估。分配器应依赖任务侧的排序证据（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: BRAVE通过预算化分配推荐智能体训练时的LLM反思，在保持全目录排序与推理重排序效果的同时减少不必要的反思计算以提升效率，并通过部署时审计防范对偏好稀疏或小众用户个性化削弱的潜在风险。
en_tdlr: BRAVE improves the efficiency of recommendation agents by budgeting training-time LLM reflection allocation, reducing unnecessary reflection while preserving full-catalog ranking and inference reranking, with deployment-time auditing to mitigate risks of weakening personalization for sparse-preference users.
